choice.scene: A snow-covered mountain citadel battlement in midwinter
choice.moment: after protecting the northern gate against a snowstorm
choice.creative_intent: Test winter-first design and authentic metal armor with selective leg-line styling instead of default warm-weather linen wrap
choice.frame_intent: Show engraved steel armor, a hand at the repaired crest and the snowy gate without demanding full body
choice.emotion_tone: Exhausted vigilance settles into quiet satisfaction as the gate holds against the winter squall.

costume_plan.climate_context: Midwinter snowfall at a high mountain fortress; the cold must remain in the final scene.
costume_plan.occupational_basis: A knight wears recognizably protective articulated plate armor rather than a generic decorative cloth top.
costume_plan.structural_silhouette: Steel cuirass, contoured pauldrons, gauntlets, and armored skirt over protected underlayers.
costume_plan.feminine_adaptation: Sculpt the armor waist and sculpted plates; an asymmetric skirt opening can show a graceful leg line without removing the cuirass.

camera_style.name: Winter documentary fantasy armor portrait
camera_style.optics: 50mm f/2.8 lens with true shoulder and gauntlet proportions
camera_style.lighting: oblique cold sunrise rim lighting through snow, distant watch fires in soft focus
camera_style.palette: smoky steel, deep garnet, blue snow and pale ivory frost
camera_style.texture: weathered steel patina, oiled leather grain, frosted fur tips and windblown hair
camera_style.framing: knee-up candid beside the icy parapet, no forced full body

scene_design.subject: An adult East Asian winter citadel knight inspects a repaired gate crest after holding the fortress through a blizzard.
scene_design.setting: On an icy stone rampart above a snowy mountain pass; wind drives fine snow past the old steel gate as sunrise catches the towers.
scene_design.action: With her right gauntlet she secures a loosened crest fastener on the parapet; her left gloved palm steadies the fixed stone rail.
scene_design.cue1: A restored gilded crest bears fresh rivets and a matching engraved insignia on her polished cuirass.
scene_design.cue2: An ice-encrusted warning bell and a coil of frozen signal rope lie below the battlement, evidence of the long overnight watch.
scene_design.wardrobe: Engraved steel cuirass and pauldrons, fitted oiled leather harness, fur-lined cape, asymmetrical armored skirt revealing a thigh over thermal layers, gauntlets and greaves.
scene_design.composition: Knee-up winter candid with the crest, armored hands and face in focus.
scene_design.expression: Her tired eyebrows relax into a relieved, disbelieving half-smile as she watches the fastener hold.
scene_design.action_physics: Right elbow bends with gloved fingers turning one fastener; left palm presses the fixed stone rail, both feet planted for balance.
